purpose: Non-overlapping synthetic recovery gate, then a single common-map screen on all applicable LP2 pages. Stop quickly if the frozen necessary score condition fails.
basis: FEED-011 and H031-v2 explicitly specify all 24360 PGL maps including the separator point.
Static review found v2 gate private-data shape and one-page/three-page scoring inconsistencies; preserve v2 unchanged and test a corrected isolated gate.
representation: 0..28 rune indices; 29 represents an actual synthetic word separator. This is a test of an explicitly extended 30-point alphabet, not a reinterpretation of GP prime values.
enumeration: 24360 canonical PGL matrices exactly as H031-v2; select equal-weight mean score across first two pages; freeze mapping for page three; tie tolerance 1e-12 and lexicographic matrix order.
scorer: H031-v2 add-one 30-symbol first-order model trained only on training.txt.
threshold: Training-only calibration: flattened training text including separators; for lengths 96,128,160,192,224 score windows starting at 0,47,94,... while fully inside training. Threshold=min(window scores)-0.25. No heldout answer influences threshold.
gate_generation: Within each job use three contiguous non-overlapping slices, lengths [96,128,160,192,224] cycled at i%20; start=(i%20*47+11) modulo (source length minus sum of three lengths plus 1). Same positions/lengths for positives and negatives. Positive matrices unchanged. Negative classes uniform, within-page permutation, common S30, seed 33011532. Across jobs windows overlap; do not treat 20 examples as independent natural corpora.
success: At least 18/20 exact inverse mapping recoveries with discovery and heldout scores above the fixed threshold; 0/99 negatives pass both scores. Independent selected-map scores, full 30-point bijections, inverses and scalar score equivalence required.
failure: Synthetic failure is inconclusive and does not dispatch LP2. If gate passes, freeze one matrix from D and compute H scores. Necessary screen requires D mean >= training-only threshold and at least two H pages >= threshold. Failure is negative only for this fixed common-map absolute-score screen, not a formal maxT/PGL family exclusion. Passing screen is an unverified lead requiring separately registered controls.
independent_validation: Separate Fermat modular inverse implementation verifies all mapping tables, determinants and 730800 point images, inverse round trips, and selected-map scores. Scalar scoring on all matrices of first public job checks optimized scorer equivalence.

formal_screen.candidate_acceptance: none; this version can only screen or propose a lead
formal_screen.worker: Discovery selection receives no holdout scores; independent scalar verification for D/H and exact inverse round trip.
